issues.quote: Revenue fell to $94.8 billion in fiscal 2025 from $97.7 billion in fiscal 2024, a decline of 10.4%.
issues.problem: A drop from $97.7B to $94.8B is about 3.0%, not 10.4%.

data.summary: Most of the figures and margins check out, but the revenue decline is wrong: it is about 3.0%, not 10.4%.
